notes.title: Patch #1 is up! Impossible Mode added!
notes.content:
Our first patch is available now and contains a bunch of fixes plus some new stuff for you to check out. If you thought Hard more was for babies wait until you get a load of Impossible, the newly added difficulty level! On the other end of the spectrum we've made Easy and Medium a little easier to handle (particularly Easy, where enemies now have a random chance to drop loot crates filled with Ship Bits).

There's a ton more. Full release notes below.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- On "Easy" difficulty, enemies may drop chests containing Ship Bits
- New "Impossible" difficulty, for those who want an even bigger challenge. Added an achievement for beating it too!
- Made it easier to unlock some of the early starter kits
- A variety of tweaks to King Kevin's traps
- Fixed issues with turrets' stun behavior, including a bug where the sound effect would persist
- Reduced range of MiniBoom Rockets
- Fixed a tuning error with RipSaw in which it was absurdly powerful at later levels
- Reduced volume of some overly loud sound effects (mine beeping, Ship Bit healing)
- Moved position of "Jump Now" button so that it doesn't get in your way so much

notes.title: Captain Forever Remix has LAUNCHED! We're out of Early Access!
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/6i7KVmJOwGc
Check out the launch trailer! We're on sale for launch week!

Whether you're new to the game or an Early Access old-timer there's something new to check out in the final launch version of the game! So check out the launch trailer, and this mini trailer that gives a sneak-peek at the new stuff:

https://youtu.be/ZiN_hZrNpEM
Are you new to Captain Forever Remix? Let Northernlion, Lovely Momo, and Retromation explain it:

https://youtu.be/tVgVzYRSZa0
Here's our release notes!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- We're happy to finally launch the finished game out of Early Access! Thanks to all players for your support and feedback.
- King Kevin has laid traps across the solar system for you to run into.
- You might also find health pickups or treasure chests containing spare ship bits!
- We've added 30 Steam Achievements!
- For more variety, we've added 6 background music tracks.
- If you like the music, you can now buy the soundtrack.
- Variant character portraits for Kevin and Captain Forever/Natalie will appear during conversations.
- Kevin's brought a few new Krusaders into the fray!
- The starter kits have been overhauled. Their contents have changed, as have their unlock requirements.
- You can now select from easy, medium, and hard difficulty levels. Difficulty level affects enemy aggressiveness, the toughness of King Kevin's traps, and the amount of time you get to build after each stage.
- There's a new power bulkhead: "Build Time." If attached, you'll get bonus time to rebuild when you complete a stage.
- Only ship bits that are attached to your ship will travel with you when you jump to the next stage.
- For better balance, weapon tuning has been tweaked.
- Lots of polish and bugfixing to get the game ready for full release!

notes.title: Update #8 - Prettier Backgrounds and Steam Workshop!
notes.content:
Hey gang, update #8 is out NOW and we've got bunch of news to share about the rest of the project!

So what's in this update?

First up, we focused on improving ship sharing by adding Steam Workshop support. Sharing ships was a much beloved part of the original Captain Forever games, and so with Remix we wanted to make it easier than ever to share your ships with your friends and the community. So go check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=298560&browsesort=mostrecent&section=readytouseitems] Workshop:[/url] we’ve already shared a bunch of [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198134773586/myworkshopfiles?appid=298560] awesome ships for you to check out! [/url]

Next: the game looks about 3000% better now (this is accurate. I did the math). There’s been a massive overhaul of all of our foreground and background effects. The stars will now remind you of those glow-in-the-dark stickers you had on your bedroom ceiling as a kid, and our nebulas are more vivid and varied (sometimes they look crispy, or creamy, or crunchy). But enough words! A picture is worth a thousand words, and a video is worth roughly 6 million. I’m too lazy to write those words so here’s a video:

https://youtu.be/Kf8_6MNCMo4

So what’s next for the project? [b]The next update marks our exit from Steam Early Access.[/b] That’s right; we’re exiting Steam Early Access when we put out update #9, which will be the 1.0 version of Captain Forever Remix. We’re aiming to do that early next year, which means there’s going to be a bit more time than usual between now and the next update. But it’ll be worth it. We’re going to be hard at work on polish, bug fixing, stability, and performance. We’d love to throw in a surprise or two as well.

That means that if you’re one of our beloved Early Access players, now is the time to get in any [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298560/discussions/] last bits of feedback you have about the game.[/url] In particular we want to hear about your experience with the new Workshop ship-sharing stuff, so go check that out and show us your best ships!

Thanks everyone! Read on below for our full release notes and some instructions from Brian about how to use the Workshop and preserve your old ship favorites.

-Dean

[h1]Notes on Sandbox in Update #8[/h1]

Sharing your Sandbox ships to Steam Workshop is an experimental new feature in this release. We need your help in making this feature robust, bug-free, and easy-to-use. Please post in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298560/discussions/] forums[/url] to let us know of any issues that you run into!

Did your Favorite ships disappear from the game? Never fear--they’re still there, just hiding. As part of this update, we had to change the disk location of your Favorites. In order for the game to see the Favorites you’ve previously saved, please move the contents of your "Favorites" folder as follows:

[b]On Windows:[/b]
[list]
[*]Old location: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\cap4ever\cap4ever_Data\ShipData\Favorites
[*]New location: C:\Users\YOURNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Pixelsaurus Games\Captain Forever Remix\Favorites
[/list]
[b]On Mac:[/b]
[list]
[*]Old location: ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/SteamApps/common/cap4ever/cap4ever.app/Contents/ShipData/Favorites
[*]New location: ~/Library/Application Support/Pixelsaurus Games/Captain Forever Remix/Favorites
[/list]
[b]On Linux:[/b]
[list]
[*]Old location: ~/.local/share/Steam/SteamApps/common/cap4ever/cap4ever_Data/ShipData/Favorites
[*]New location: ~/.config/unity3d/Pixelsaurus Games/Captain Forever Remix/Favorites
[/list]

Thanks for understanding and for helping us get Captain Forever Remix ready for a full release!

-Brian

notes.title: Update #7: Captain Forever in the Cloud!
notes.content:
By popular demand: [b]we now support saving to Steam Cloud[/b]! This means that your game progress, ship history, and favorite ships should automatically sync between any same-platform computers where you play Captain Forever Remix.

To support Steam Cloud saves, we had to monkey with the save game system a bit. We believe that any progress you made prior to this update should carry over to the new system without issue!

If you have past progress that somehow isn't carrying over, let us know and we'll attempt to fix it! (We're pretty sure it's still there...just hiding, not gone forever.) We want to make sure this system is working robustly, so holler to let us know how we did!

In this update, we've also [b]remixed the user interface[/b] to fit better with the style we're going for. We're also displaying some [b]new stats for each starter kit[/b]: the furthest stage you've reached and how many times you've completed the game with that kit...more of that to come!

notes.title: Update #6: PAX Prime Prep Polish
notes.content:
Hey folks! As previously mentioned, we're super-excited to bring Captain Forever Remix to [url=indiemegabooth.com/event/pax-prime-2015/]Indie Megabooth[/url] at [url=prime.paxsite.com/]PAX Prime 2015[/url] on August 28-31, 2015. To prepare for this, we've been focusing on bug-fixing and polish. We decided to bundle up some of those fixes for this month's update...here they are!
[list]
[*]Added Vsync option
[*]Clarified the presentation of Power Bulkheads throughout the UI
[*]New "Skip to next round" cheat in Sandbox Mode
[*]Projectiles fade visually after being fired
[*]Reduced damage and health of MegaBoom Rockets
[*]Cutter Beam and RipSaw weapons can now damage shields
[*]Fixed bug where Repair Bulkhead visual effects weren't playing properly
[*]Fixed bug where MegaBoom Rockets could collide with shields on the same ship
[*]Fixed bug where cash shows up during Starter Kit selection
[/list]
We'll continue to make small tweaks like these until our demo at PAX. After that, we've got much bigger changes planned! Stay tuned, and thanks for playing.

notes.title: Ship Bits Mega Pak is out NOW!
notes.content:
[url=http://imgur.com/Pvonge5][img]http://i.imgur.com/Pvonge5.png[/img][/url]

[b]The Ship Bits Mega Pak update is out now! [/b]
It's never been a better time to jump into Captain Forever Remix! Check out our trailer for the update!

https://youtu.be/V5L6PhLqjgk

We're absolutely psyched about this update and it's our biggest one yet. Thanks so much for joining us during Ship Bits Mega Week - Brian and I had a blast revealing all of the stuff we've been working on. It's a lot of stuff. Let's review, shall we?

[h1] Day 1: the SCATTERBLASTER and MEGABOOM ROCKET! [/h1]

On Day 1 we announced the SCATTERBLASTER! Create bullet hell for your enemies!

[url=http://imgur.com/LVi6RIo][img]http://i.imgur.com/LVi6RIo.gif[/img][/url]

And the MEGABOOM ROCKET! You'll only need one, but six is more fun!

[url=http://imgur.com/jSoaR0v][img]http://i.imgur.com/jSoaR0v.gif[/img][/url]

[h1] Day 2: the Mine Popper and Extra-Long Repair Bulkheads [/h1]

What sound does a mine make when it gets launched into space? "POP!"

What about when it explodes? "POP!"

It's the Mine Popper!

[url=http://imgur.com/xnGM7l6][img]http://i.imgur.com/xnGM7l6.gif[/img][/url]

Repair bulkheads now come in extra-long varieties, and they'll appear every time you play (along with Bubble Shields!). Keep your spaceship ship-shaped at all times!

[url=http://imgur.com/zs4QK3y][img]http://i.imgur.com/zs4QK3y.png[/img][/url] 

[h1] Day 3: Jumbo Bulkhead Lite and DRAGON BREATH! [/h1]

On Day 3 we announced something really big: the Jumbo Bulkhead Lite!

[url=http://imgur.com/q76zj4Y][img]http://i.imgur.com/q76zj4Y.gif[/img][/url]

And then something really hot and dragon-ish: the DRAGON BREATH! You don’t *have* to attach these to a ship that’s shaped like a dragon, but it doesn’t hurt! 

[url=http://imgur.com/gZ8glis][img]http://i.imgur.com/gZ8glis.gif[/img][/url]

[h1] Day 4: Power Bulkheads! [/h1]

It's a pretty huge update so far right? Then we kept going. On Saturday we revealed the biggest game-changer yet: Power Bulkheads.

[url=http://imgur.com/agnHwDm][img]http://i.imgur.com/agnHwDm.png[/img][/url]

These are basically a complete overhaul of the old "upgrades" system.
Each one gives you a boost for unique special powers. So for example “Knockout” gives you the chance to stun your enemies when you damage them, and having more “Knockout” bulkheads on your ship will increase the chance for that to happen. 

Power Bulkheads are carried by high-level enemies, so you’ll want to be extra careful picking their ships apart so that you don’t destroy them during the battle.

The update is available now. Jump back into the game if you haven't played in a while, and tell your friends about us!

Thanks again for following Ship Bits Mega Week and we hope you enjoy all these new toys.

-Dean

Repair bulkheads now come in extra-long varieties, and they'll appear every time you play (along with Bubble Shields!). Keep your spaceship ship-shaped at all times!

[url=http://imgur.com/zs4QK3y][img]http://i.imgur.com/zs4QK3y.png[/img][/url] 

[h1] Day 3: Jumbo Bulkhead Lite and DRAGON BREATH! [/h1]

On Day 3 we announced something really big: the Jumbo Bulkhead Lite!

[url=http://imgur.com/q76zj4Y][img]http://i.imgur.com/q76zj4Y.gif[/img][/url]

And then something really hot and dragon-ish: the DRAGON BREATH! You don’t *have* to attach these to a ship that’s shaped like a dragon, but it doesn’t hurt! 

[url=http://imgur.com/gZ8glis][img]http://i.imgur.com/gZ8glis.gif[/img][/url]

[h1] Day 4: Power Bulkheads! [/h1]

It's a pretty huge update so far right? Then we kept going. On Saturday we revealed the biggest game-changer yet: Power Bulkheads.

[url=http://imgur.com/agnHwDm][img]http://i.imgur.com/agnHwDm.png[/img][/url]

These are basically a complete overhaul of the old "upgrades" system.
Each one gives you a boost for unique special powers. So for example “Knockout” gives you the chance to stun your enemies when you damage them, and having more “Knockout” bulkheads on your ship will increase the chance for that to happen. 

Power Bulkheads are carried by high-level enemies, so you’ll want to be extra careful picking their ships apart so that you don’t destroy them during the battle.

The update is available now. Jump back into the game if you haven't played in a while, and tell your friends about us!

Thanks again for following Ship Bits Mega Week and we hope you enjoy all these new toys.

-Dean

notes.title: An update on our Early Access development plans
notes.content:
Hey gang!

We’ve just hit a really big milestone (bang! Crash!). The game is now in a state where it includes all of the features that we set out to make for it in Early Access. Over the course of the last couple of months, we’ve:

-Added sandbox mode, along with unlockable cheats.
-Added the ability to share ships with your friends.
-Added 4 new modules.
-Added a bunch of new characters to Kevin’s Krusaders.
-Fixed tons of bugs, done tons of polish, and tuned the heck out of the game.

In the last update (Update #4: Get Your Butt to Pluto!), we wrapped a bow on the last few loose ends in the game, the biggest one being a “real” ending when you get to Pluto and kick Kevin’s butt.

So that’s it huh? The game is finished? Not so fast, mister!

We’ve really enjoyed being in Early Access and the feedback we’ve gotten from you all has been invaluable and heartening. And we’re just having too much dang fun working on the game. So even though we’ve completed the work we set out to in Early Access, we’re going to keep working on the game a while longer so that we can make Captain Forever Remix even better than it already is. Our schedule for releasing updates is going to change somewhat: we’re shifting to monthly releases, so that we can have more time to work on each one. We’ll have more details on what you can expect to see in those updates soon.

Join us, won’t you?

-Dean and Brian.

notes.title: Update #4: Get Your Butt to Pluto!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/7Uy60Dd.png[/img]

Hey guys! It’s time to go grab Update #4, the “Get your Butt to Pluto!” update!

Why’s it called the “Get your Butt to Pluto!” update? Well, that’s because there’s never been a better time to get your butt to Pluto and kick King Kevin’s uh...butt. Although, wait a sec - he doesn’t have one. Because he’s a giant fluorescent pink disembodied mutant head.

Anywho. The game now has a real ending, complete with sweet new visuals and sounds! No more “temp screen with some text on it” shenanigans! No siree. So get your butt to Pluto and bask in the glory of...A REAL ENDING.

And that’s probably not even the most exciting thing in this update. We’ve made some pretty meaty changes to combat tuning and difficulty. Long story short, the game is still tough as nails and requires you to build a pretty sweet ship. BUT! Combat now feels more tactical, more “fair.” This is due to changes to how weapon range increases with level. It used to be that weapon range would increase quite a bit as they leveled up, and you’d end up getting blasted to pieces by higher-level enemies before you could even get in range to fight them on even footing. This effect has now been drastically lessened. The range differences between individual weapon types now have much more meaning. Of course, this being a pretty huge change, we’d love to get your feedback. So please let us know what you think in the forums.

Oh wait! That’s not even the most exciting thing in this update! I almost forgot: the options menu has some new audio, video, and control settings! Ok fine, so maybe that isn’t the most exciting thing, but it’s totally necessary and something that’s been lacking for quite a while now. It’s great to have it working in-game finally!

There’s a bunch of other smaller changes and bug fixes in this update, and we’ve also cut down the install size of the game. This should make it quicker to download, and easier on your hard drive!

This update is our biggest yet, and thus took a little longer than usual. Apologies for that, but we think it’s been worth the wait so that we could make these changes and properly finish up the game’s finale.

So have fun and build rad spaceships! We’ll have more news on the general future of the project really soon.

Cheers!

-Dean and Brian

notes.title: We're delaying Update #4 a bit
notes.content:
Hey folks! Some quick news on our next update.

We've been working towards tying up the biggest loose ends in the game. Which means adding things like a real options menu and making optimizations to the game's performance and install size. This stuff isn't glamorous, but it's necessary. We've also been working on the game's finale sequence, which is indeed very glamorous, and it's coming along really well, but it's not quite ready for prime time. 

We debated doing an update tomorrow that would just include a new options menu and some small performance improvements, but have decided to instead delay the next update until those features are fully baked and also until the finale is actually finished. Better to wait a bit and have something really exciting for you all to check out when you beat the game. So, no update this week, but we'll be getting one out next week that will include the new finale.

-Dean

notes.title: Update #3: share ships with your friends!
notes.content:
[url=http://imgur.com/TtUZhmY][img]http://i.imgur.com/TtUZhmY.png[/img][/url]

Hi folks! Update #3 is now live with some new features that we’re really excited about!

[h1]Ship Sharing[/h1]

You can now save your favorite ship designs, give them a name, and share them with your friends using THE POWER OF THE INTERNET! Shared ships can be used in Sandbox Mode. More details below on how to share ships!

[h1]Sandbox Cheats[/h1]

You can now access various cheats in Sandbox Mode, such as invincibility, AI level controls, and my personal favorite: RANDOM REBUILD! Here it is in action:

[url=http://imgur.com/4TBr2d6][img]http://i.imgur.com/4TBr2d6.gif[/img][/url]

Press “TAB” when in Sandbox Mode to access the cheats menu.

[h1]Tweaks to game difficulty[/h1]

We’re tweaked a bunch of stuff that affects difficulty, mostly to do with how enemies spawn. The game is now a little easier and more “fair” but getting to Pluto should still present a massive challenge.

[h1]New Krusaders![/h1]

Two new mutant animals have joined Kevin’s Krusaders. One of them loves to eat cheese, the other one loves to make cheese. Can you guess what they are? Keep an eye out for them on your adventures!

[h1]A prettier end to the game![/h1]

The payoff for getting to Pluto and destroying a Peacemaker is a little more explosive now. We’re still working on the game’s finale, and this is the first step. Here’s a sneak-peak of what you’ll get to see if you make it to Pluto!

[url=http://imgur.com/wBCQVoU][img]http://i.imgur.com/wBCQVoU.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Bug Fixes![/h1]

As usual, there are tons of bug fixes, including many fixes that were requested on the forums. If you run into new bugs, please let us know!

[b] That covers it for Update #3! [/b] As always, if you’ve got feedback we’d love to hear it on the forums. Read on for instructions on how to share ships with your friends. Happy ship sharing!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Detailed instructions: How to share ships with your friends[/h1]

Sharing ships with your friends is really simple. Your saved ships are all accessible in Sandbox Mode, which is listed on the Main Menu:

[url=http://imgur.com/J3tX3Cf][img]http://i.imgur.com/J3tX3Cf.png[/img][/url]

In Sandbox Mode, you can browse your recently-built ships. If you want to permanently save a ship as a “favorite,” just click the “favorite” button.

To view your favorite ships, click the “favorites” button at the top of the screen. You can share these ships with your friends. Just click either the folder or file name to show your Favorites folder:

[url=http://imgur.com/z5lhDQK][img]http://i.imgur.com/z5lhDQK.png[/img][/url]

This’ll open up the folder where all of your favorite ships are kept. Each ship has its own .CFS file. The currently-selected ship’s file will be highlighted, making it really easy to copy-paste it for sharing with your friends via the method of your choice (email, Dropbox, etc.).

If you want to play with a ship shared by a friend, simply copy their shared .CFS file into this folder. Their ship will appear automatically when you start the game (under “Favorites” in the Sandbox).

This is the first version of this feature, and we hope to make ship sharing even simpler in future updates. There are a couple of issues to be aware of:

1) In the previous update (#2), we allowed you to name a ship in order to save it. Any ship you’ve named in the old version will need to be favorited if you want to hang on to it.
2) Clicking the folder or file name to show the Favorites folder only works on Windows and Mac. On Linux, you’ll need to navigate to your Favorites folder manually.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
[url=http://imgur.com/5pKC5Qn][img]http://i.imgur.com/5pKC5Qn.png[/img][/url]

Hi folks! Update #2 is now live and includes the beginnings of a hotly-requested feature: 

[h1]Sandbox Mode![/h1]

We envision Sandbox Mode as a place to freely and endlessly experiment with ship building. As in the regular game mode, you'll still be blowing up a limitless variety of colorful enemy ships (and their equally colorful pilots).

[h1]New Krusaders![/h1]

Speaking of pilots: Kevin's got a few new Krusaders up his sleeve! Look out for these lovable hooligans on your next run.

[h1]Save Your Ship Designs![/h1]

We know you get pretty attached to all those ships you're creating, so we've added features to save your ship designs. We keep a rolling list of the last 512 ships you've created. If you want to save a particular ship for safekeeping, simply give it a custom name--the wackier, the better!. Any ship you create will automatically be available in Sandbox mode.

We're super grateful for the feedback and requests we've already received from everyone. Please keep sharing your thoughts on the game, especially the new Sandbox Mode!

Here's the full change log:
[list]
[*] We've started building a new Sandbox mode! Play endlessly with any ship you've previously created.
[*] You can now view and save your favorite ship designs after each game.
[*] Ship designs are saved on the Starter Kit screen so that you don't have to rebuild each time you change kits.
[*] New characters: A gruff old goat. Sailor Eel. New Peacemakers!
[/list]

Speaking of pilots: Kevin's got a few new Krusaders up his sleeve! Look out for these lovable hooligans on your next run.

[h1]Save Your Ship Designs![/h1]

We know you get pretty attached to all those ships you're creating, so we've added features to save your ship designs. We keep a rolling list of the last 512 ships you've created. If you want to save a particular ship for safekeeping, simply give it a custom name--the wackier, the better!. Any ship you create will automatically be available in Sandbox mode.

We're super grateful for the feedback and requests we've already received from everyone. Please keep sharing your thoughts on the game, especially the new Sandbox Mode!

Here's the full change log:
[list]
[*] We've started building a new Sandbox mode! Play endlessly with any ship you've previously created.
[*] You can now view and save your favorite ship designs after each game.
[*] Ship designs are saved on the Starter Kit screen so that you don't have to rebuild each time you change kits.
[*] New characters: A gruff old goat. Sailor Eel. New Peacemakers!
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1 is available!
notes.content:
[url=http://imgur.com/oX5AE17][img]http://i.imgur.com/oX5AE17.png[/img][/url]

The first update is now out! New modules! New characters! Bug fixes! Go go go! Here are the details:

[b]Added 4 new experimental modules, which are...[/b]

- #1: the MEGA SAW! It's like the Ripsaw, but massive and frightening.
- #2: the PIERCING LASER! It fires special projectiles that cut through enemy modules and keep on going!
- #3: BURST MISSILE LAUNCHER! It fires three teeny tiny cute missiles all at once.
- #4: TRIPLE PLASMA CANNON! Surprise surprise: it shoots three plasma balls at once. It might be too powerful. It is an experiment.

[b] New characters and dialogue! [/b]

- Tons of new dialogue. Kevin's Krusaders are now 30% more sassy.
- Added 2 new characters: a creepy barn owl, and POE THE CORGI!

[b] BUG FIXES and DESIGN CHANGES! [/b]

- Renamed the "Torpedo Launcher" to "Plasma Cannon" and gave it a new look.
- Ships can no longer shoot down their own projectiles.
- Destroying a +2 level enemy no longer causes you to skip a stage.
- Fixed bug where projectiles would bounce on collision.
- Fixed bug where ripsaws were not vulnerable to projectile damage.

Here's Poe working on her own portrait for the game...

[url=http://imgur.com/oNqk5bW][img]http://i.imgur.com/oNqk5bW.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update #1 is on the way!
notes.content:
[url=http://imgur.com/xXbEkwp][img]http://i.imgur.com/xXbEkwp.png[/img][/url]

Hey gang!

Captain Forever Remix Update #1 is on the way! It'll be released either late tomorrow (Friday) or early Saturday. Either way, that means this weekend there's MORE CAPTAIN FOREVER REMIX TO ENJOY!

This update is going to include a few new module types, some new characters and dialogue, and a bunch of bug fixes. We could be more specific, but we don't want to ruin the surprise.

Brian and I have been hard at work since the game launched. We've spent most of our time listening to you guys, gathering feedback, and getting a feel for what people would like to see out of future updates. It's been a really fun couple of weeks and we can't wait to finally start pumping out updates!

-Dean
